reactions: [Hacker News] This is much better than I anticipated. I don't mind AI that much, but this version of HN surfaces really interesting articles I've missed.
[Hacker News] So what now? That's how you do it in real life too, don't you? Sure, real life isn't exactly IRC, hehe, but you get the point.
[Hacker News] Great feedback. After all this time I just realized a lot of people may not even know that menu exists. It's been like that for so long I'm literally blind to it.
[Hacker News] HN reflects what their users (or people trying to influence them) post most. A few years ago it was flooded with crypto, a few years later it will be flooded with something else.
[Hacker News] Nice. The word "show" threw me off, given it is on the far right and the cog is on the far left. Menu, settings, config etc would make more sense.
[Hacker News] Alternatively, go to /newest and vote for what you want to see on the front page.
[Hacker News] Thanks! I always forget to update the changelog for a bunch of stuff. I'm glad you have eyes on it, I'll be more mindful to add to it.

[Hacker News] It's literally not recommended right on the About page, along the lines of "you shouldn't ask for invite right after joining, hang around chat instead". Well, I've checked it. They are talking about Trump something or other. None of those users I know at any level. So what's that "hanging out" entails then? Go invade a chat between acquaintances and randomly
[Hacker News] Help me out here. Is AI something prevalent on HN now? I check the site a lot but just browse headlines and visit some sites.
[Hacker News] Not really, you can ask in the chat room for an invitation.
[Hacker News] >and "prompt" is regularly used in headlines regarding political news. Oh no! Anyway...
